rows.title: GTM Automation & Growth Engineer
rows.why: The eligibility line is 'only open to candidates residing in the EU/EEA or Switzerland who already hold the legal right to work' — his EU long-term residence permit is the exact qualifier, and it removes most competition. Tool list is n8n, Make, Clay, Apify, Scrapingbee, Lemlist, Pipedrive, Airtable, Baserow: the same combination he used at FlowSpace for sales-funnel automation, lead enrichment and the data-scraping tools that grew platform listings.
rows.watch_outs: join.com shows 'updated 4 minutes ago' but no original publish date, and the posting id (15338019) is lower than others on the same board, so the req may have been running a while — ask how long it has been open. Remote vs Berlin-onsite is never stated in the posting; German is not required anywhere in the text but this is a German company. No comp disclosed.

rows.title: Forward-Deployed CRM Architect
rows.why: Embedded delivery with a handful of client companies is literally the pitch behind his breadth across eight European companies — FlowSpace, Urlink, Qomodo, Clubee — and the CET-overlap requirement makes Venice ideal rather than marginal. Stack is HubSpot, Salesforce, n8n, Clay, Apollo, Apify, Aircall, Clearbit, mapping onto his CRM lead-capture integrations and scraping/parsing work; the posting makes daily AI-tool use mandatory, which is his Claude Code and OpenAI API habit.
rows.watch_outs: GTM Base is an AI-first RevOps/GTM agency, so client names are not disclosed — verify who he'd actually be embedded with before signing. 'Deep HubSpot expertise' is the headline requirement and his CRM work is integration-side rather than HubSpot administration. German is listed as nice-to-have because a good chunk of the client base is DACH. No rate or salary disclosed.

rows.title: GTM Engineer
rows.location: London, United Kingdom (isRemote: true on the posting record)
rows.why: The named toolset is Clay, HubSpot, Attio, n8n, Make, Zapier and Claude — the closest line-for-line match to his CV of anything in this sweep, covering the sales-funnel automations, lead enrichment and outbound he built at FlowSpace plus the n8n agent work. Ben is a benefits scale-up where one person would own the GTM automation surface end to end.
rows.watch_outs: Tier 2, and the ambiguity is real: the Ashby posting record says isRemote true, but every role on Ben's board is London with workplace type hybrid. His EU permit does not cover UK on-site employment, so confirm in the first message whether they can engage someone based in Italy (contractor or EOR) before investing in the process. No comp disclosed and no years-of-experience figure surfaced.

rows.title: Senior GTM Engineer
rows.why: Explicitly a 'contract / part-time role with a path to full-time', which is his normal working mode rather than a fallback, and Clay is the primary tool alongside HubSpot, Salesforce, n8n, Claude and GPT — the outbound and enrichment half of his FlowSpace work. Worth applying to alongside their Forward-Deployed CRM Architect req since one conversation can cover both.
rows.watch_outs: Oldest row here at 159 days, and the same role appears twice on their board (ids 16454531 and 15983148), which reads like an evergreen req rather than a funded vacancy — ask directly whether there is a live engagement behind it. Agency model with unnamed clients. No rate disclosed despite being a contract role, so raise the day rate early.

rows.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (CRM)
rows.why: 'Remote within Europe' with no German requirement at a German employer, building the CRM and lifecycle-messaging layer on Braze and Iterable — the same lifecycle-automation surface as his Sendgrid and CRM lead-capture integrations. PHP/Symfony is the same language as the Laravel half of the Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel migration he led.
rows.watch_outs: Asks for 5+ years as a Senior Full Stack Developer against his ~3, so this is a stretch application. Framework fit is adjacent rather than exact: Symfony not Laravel, Vue not Next.js, and Braze/Iterable are new to him. Least AI/automation surface of any row here — closer to lifecycle engineering than agent work. No comp and no posted date.

rows.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
rows.location: Czech Republic or Slovakia, covering EMEA
rows.why: Rare posting in this vocabulary that states '2-5 years of professional experience' and 'Fluent English - this is your primary working language', so both the seniority band and the language gate are clean. The technical content is APIs, data integrations, webhooks, JSON and SQL against a CDP and marketing-automation product, which is his integration work at Office RnD, Nexudus and Clubee in a pre-sales frame.
rows.watch_outs: Tier 3 / Relocation — the eligibility line is 'Based in the Czech Republic or Slovakia, comfortable covering EMEA with occasional travel', so this needs a move and his Italian long-term residence permit would have to be transferred. Salary band is modest. Named tools are categories (CDPs, CRMs) rather than anything he has shipped. Only worth it if he is genuinely open to leaving Venice.

rows.title: Growth Engineer
rows.location: Remote (no country qualifier on the posting record)
rows.why: Growth Engineer at a small remote-first data-infrastructure company is the build-and-instrument end of the growth function — landing pages, funnel instrumentation, self-serve activation — which is what his 2,000 to 4,500+ user growth work at FlowSpace actually consisted of. Kept because it is one of very few Growth Engineer reqs in this sweep with no US-only clause on the record.

All three roles on Goldsky's board were published within two minutes of each other on 2026-05-12, which looks like a board refresh rather than three fresh reqs. Crypto/web3 domain, no comp disclosed, and the JD's stack is unknown — read it before applying.
